players.product: Chinese OSAT (Tongfu Microelectronics) buying Hanmi packaging equipment

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 16.04 billion, up 23.03% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1.72 billion, up 316.77%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 747.46 million, up 77.78%; operating cash flow RMB 2.93 billion, up 18.25%. Fair-value gains of RMB 1,144,915,189.49 (mainly on trading and other non-current financial assets) were 53.56% of total profit. The company attributes the profit jump to higher revenue, especially a marked rise in mid-to-high-end product revenue, and to investment gains from its supply-chain investments; it describes H1 as 'revenue acceleration, a higher mid-to-high-end product share and a big profit jump'.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 16.04 billion (+23.03%); net profit RMB 1.72 billion (+316.77%)

quarterly_data.signal: Segments and regions (half-year report): IC packaging and test revenue RMB 15.69 billion in H1 2026, 97.81% of revenue, up 24.08%, gross margin 15.12% (up 0.73 points); domestic revenue RMB 5.87 billion, 36.60% of revenue, up 45.19%; overseas revenue RMB 10.17 billion, 63.40%, up 13.07%; packaging and test gross margin 14.91% domestic and 15.24% overseas. R&D spend RMB 825.46 million, up 9.25%. Contract liabilities (customer prepayments) RMB 512.38 million at June 30, up 133.59%, which the company attributes to higher advance payments from customers.
quarterly_data.figure: IC packaging and test revenue RMB 15.69 billion (+24.08%), gross margin 15.12%; domestic revenue +45.19%

quarterly_data.signal: Business lines in H1 2026 (half-year report): the company focuses on four growth curves - AI, memory, automotive and domestic customers - and says market expansion and capacity utilization both strengthened. Advanced packaging's share of revenue rose steadily, with several products in volume introduction into high-performance computing and inference chips. Automotive packaging and test revenue kept high-double-digit growth, with products extending from automotive MCU, power devices and automotive memory to smart-cockpit controllers, chassis control and automotive-grade power and sensor packaging; display-driver output value kept double-digit growth; PMIC wafer-level packaging, SiP and bumping demand is strong with leading domestic power-management customers.
quarterly_data.figure: automotive packaging and test revenue high-double-digit growth

quarterly_data.signal: AMD plants (half-year report): TF-AMD Suzhou and TF-AMD Penang had record combined H1 2026 revenue - Suzhou revenue RMB 42.66 hundred million (net profit 3.95), Penang revenue RMB 53.95 hundred million (net profit 2.33). Both are expanding high-end capacity, production space and equipment for AI and high-compute products, which the company says effectively resolved product delivery bottlenecks; building on 3nm production in 2025 they are now focused on the 2nm technology node. Construction in progress at Penang was RMB 2,260,446,022.48 at June 30.
quarterly_data.figure: TF-AMD Suzhou revenue RMB 42.66 hundred million; TF-AMD Penang revenue RMB 53.95 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Co-packaged optics (half-year report): the company is building photonic IC (PIC) and electronic IC (EIC) heterogeneous integration on its advanced packaging platform and has provided diversified CPO solutions to multiple customers, supporting low-power optical interconnect for next-generation data-center 1.6T-and-above speeds; its CPO and thin-die hybrid SiP double-sided packaging technologies passed reliability verification.

Memory and next-generation packaging (half-year report): in high-stack memory packaging the company completed LPDDR 16DP and rNand 64DP product solution development; in vertical wire-bond advanced packaging, VFO achieved its first ES (engineering sample) package delivery and VCS completed full-line process verification; it is laying out hybrid bonding for sub-micron bumpless interconnect. Cumulative patent applications above 1,800 at June 30, 2026.

Capacity investment (half-year report): construction in progress RMB 4,554,567,236.18 at June 30, 2026, up 46.14% from end-2025, which the company attributes to business growth and more investment in mid-to-high-end production lines; equipment being installed RMB 4,200,726,606.75; cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets RMB 5,198,726,578.75 in H1, up 70.49%, mainly equipment. Major projects: Penang new plant 88.28% of budget invested and under construction; Sutong industrial park 58.88%, phases 1 and 2 completed and phase 3 under construction; Hefei industrial park 99.23%, phase 1 completed and phase 2 under construction; a new Tongke plant project (RMB 49,891,748.17). New 110KV substations at Suzhou and Penang are under construction. The 2022 raised-fund projects are complete and the funds fully used; the high-performance computing packaging and power-device packaging projects missed expected returns in H1 2026 because sharply higher commodity prices raised raw-material costs and, as the industry shifts to AI and advanced packaging, customers' chip stocks for these products were insufficient, limiting utilization; the company expects their profitability to improve as capacity ramps.
quarterly_data.figure: construction in progress RMB 4,554,567,236.18 (+46.14%); H1 cash capex RMB 5,198,726,578.75 (+70.49%)
